d: An action-packed compilation of alligator rescues brings a fresh challenge with every capture! From huge gators lurking in backyard ponds to aggressive nuisance alligators that need urgent removal, Paul Bedard, Jimmy Riffle and Ashley Lawrence take on some demanding wildlife missions across Florida and Mississippi. At Everglades Holiday Park, these experienced alligator trappers face unpredictable reptiles that make every rescue and relocation a test of skill and nerve.
